div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: 6 · REPORT — default run: four files plus console output

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: 5 · JUDGE — decide per loan, then assess the whole population

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: 4 · INSPECT — 50 checks per loan; no runtime calibration against the clean examples

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: 3 · ANCHOR — one reporting date for the tape

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: 2 · INGEST — normalise once; retain evidence, not guesses

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: 1 · READ — preserve the source; load usable input

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: validated separately

div.style: color: rgb(24, 76, 36) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Lender loan tape
Excel · CSV · Parquet · JSONL
Loan summaries + nested payments diary
Supplied workbook: 72 loan rows

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Read the table and hash the source
Handle supported file formats
No financial verdict at this stage

div.style: color: rgb(116, 61, 41) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Input guards during read / ingest
Unusable file or ambiguous schema → reject
An empty usable population is not success
Recoverable row problems do not stop other rows

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Parse known fields into typed values
Numbers · dates · IDs · labels
Missing or invalid is not silently zero

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Extract typed payment component records
Keep source row + payment sequence
Tag duplicates / settlement representations
Do not double-count the same cash

div.style: color: rgb(116, 61, 41) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center; width: 400px;

span.p:
Preserve issues and coverage
13 diaries cut at 32,767 characters
Salvage complete records; missing tails stay unknown
Quarantine unusable rows with their reasons

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Use --as-of when supplied
Otherwise infer from observed event dates
Exclude future scheduled due dates
Supplied tape: 2025-01-23

div.style: color: rgb(51, 78, 104) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center; width: 400px;

span.p:
No usable reference → require --as-of
An isolated inferred maximum produces a warning
Snapshot date is not the computer's current date

div.style: color: rgb(87, 67, 24) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center; width: 400px;

span.p:
Group 1 · RECORD CONSISTENCY — 43 checks
Usable fields and recorded ingestion issues
Summary / diary totals · amounts · pending balances
Dates · statuses · plausibility · guarded XIRR

div.style: color: rgb(87, 67, 24) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center; width: 400px;

span.p:
Group 2 · REPAYMENT BEHAVIOUR — 7 checks
Paid late / still overdue / stopped payments
30–89-day watch band · 90+ day default threshold
Habits and changes from earlier behaviour

div.style: color: rgb(87, 67, 24) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Each check returns
pass / fail / not_evaluable
Reason and appropriate evidence
Missing evidence is different from a pass

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center; width: 400px;

span.p:
Per-loan result
Link root findings and related symptoms
Severity: info → low → medium → high → critical
Default flag floor: medium
Keep integrity, credit event and coverage separate

div.style: color: rgb(87, 67, 24) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Group 3 · WHOLE-TAPE QUALITY — 6 checks
Duplicate IDs · conflicting borrower details
Severe-integrity share · digit / shared-row screens
Plus a separate export-health summary
Runs after loan results; once after shard merge

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Technical publication status
accepted / review_required / rejected
Account for evaluated and quarantined rows
Incomplete coverage can hold a completed run
Acceptance is not borrower credit approval

div.style: color: rgb(24, 76, 36) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Supplied-tape result — not a target
15 major · 10 minor · 13 indeterminate · 34 clean
15 have partial coverage: 13 truncated + 2 major
Publication: review_required

div.style: color: rgb(24, 76, 36) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
loans_report.json
Full findings, outcomes, groups and tape checks
Input SHA-256 · ruleset · config digest · as-of

div.style: color: rgb(24, 76, 36) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
loans_summary.csv
One row per loan or quarantined input row
Tier · severity · groups · axes · reasons

div.style: color: rgb(24, 76, 36) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
loans_payments.csv
One row per payment component
Dates · amounts · paid / pending · balances
Source identity and convention tags

div.style: color: rgb(24, 76, 36) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
loans_diary_coverage.csv
One row per parsed loan
Diary survival · spans · sums
Compare with loan-summary balances

div.style: color: rgb(24, 76, 36) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Console stdout
Readable summary and health observations
Capture separately as loans_console.txt

div.style: color: rgb(51, 78, 104) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center; width: 400px;

span.p:
DEVELOPMENT / CI — outside the runtime stages
admission.py → rule_admission.md
Synthetic positive / negative tests
Two clean anchors and one irregular anchor
High firing rates prompt investigation, not automatic rejection
No target flag percentage or claim of measured recall

div.style: color: rgb(51, 78, 104) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center; width: 400px;

span.p:
Interpretation boundaries
Groups are categories, not extra processing stages.
Inspect and the loan decision repeat per loan; whole-tape checks follow.
A truncated diary can still support some checks; others are not_evaluable.
XIRR differences need context. Benford cannot prove fabrication and is not_evaluable here.
Outputs remain sensitive financial data; no automatic financial correction.

svg.text: Part A · Loan-tape detector — six processing stages, three check groups
